title: Control telemetry assembler and attestation export for SOC 2 / ISO 27001
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Objective: Build a centralized 'Control Telemetry Assembler' service that collects, normalizes, and maps runtime telemetry and artifact metadata to SOC 2 and ISO 27001 control statements, and produces auditor-friendly attestation bundles filtered by region and retention policy. The service will enable scheduled and on-demand exports for auditors, preserve chain-of-custody metadata for each artifact, and enforce data residency and retention rules when assembling proofs.

Scope:
- Define a canonical control mapping schema (control_id -> observable signals, required artifacts, evidence TTL).
- Extend existing collectors to emit standardized telemetry envelopes (source, timestamp, sha256, residency_tag, retention_deadline).
- Implement an assembler that correlates signals into per-control artifacts and attaches provenance metadata.
- Export formats: timeboxed ZIP with manifest.json, signed assertions, and a CSV summary; direct API endpoints for auditor retrieval and Console button for generating one-off reports.
- Retention enforcement: assembled bundles must exclude or redact artifacts beyond their retention window and must respect region-specific residency constraints.

Non-Goals: full policy authoring UI (this ticket focuses on backend assembly and export), real-time continuous monitoring (we will support near-real-time via scheduled short-window jobs in future tickets).
acceptance_criteria: Canonical control mapping schema documented in Confluence and approved by Security
Collector clients emit telemetry envelopes with required fields (source, timestamp, residency_tag, artifact_digest)
Assembler can produce a signed attestation bundle for at least 10 controls across two regions
Export endpoint returns ZIP with manifest.json, signed-assertion.txt, and per-artifact provenance lines
Bundles pass a dry-run audit checklist (checklist doc linked) and do not include artifacts violating retention or residency policies
tasks: Design canonical control mapping schema (PM + Security + ENG review)
Add envelope schema to collector SDK and update 3 sample collectors (auth logs, audit logs, rollout traces)
Build assembler service with policy-aware filtering and provenance stitching
Add attestation signing using KMS key from compliance vault
Implement export API and Console integration (report generation flow)
Run cross-functional dry-run with Security, Legal, and a pilot customer
